authority_notice: This record is a review proposal. It does not authorize F1, product implementation, merge, release, deployment, activation, or publication.

architecture.lite_rule: Lite copies the hosted-green Full pack byte-for-byte, pins the exact Full commit, and may neither add semantics nor weaken a denial.

lite.blocking_rule: Lite L1 still waits for the future hosted-green Full F5 pin and frozen pack; admission qualification alone does not authorize conformance implementation.

D0-3.credential_wire: gkos1.gkc1_<26 lowercase RFC4648 base32 characters>.<43 unpadded base64url characters>
D0-3.digest: SHA-256(domain separator plus the decoded 32 secret bytes)
D0-3.credential_id: gkc1_ plus the first 130 digest bits in lowercase unpadded RFC4648 base32
D0-3.reveal: exactly one server-side handoff; bootstrap owner credential is atomically written to the protected persistent client locator, while later non-bootstrap issue/rotate may use a verified inherited anonymous pipe/handle or locator; no ordinary JSON/protocol output and no API re-reveal
D0-3.credential_result: credential.issue and credential.rotate use the strict credential_mutation_result: target_id is the newly active credential; first completed success sets secret_revealed true only after the out-of-band handoff succeeds; failed/lost handoff and exact idempotent replay return the same target/receipt with secret_revealed false; no credential bytes are JSON fields; rotation atomically revokes the old credential with zero grace
D0-3.post_bootstrap_owner_auth: every repeat administration command reads the protected owner-controlled client locator once per client invocation through a no-follow handle; the server stores neither plaintext nor locator path

D0-4.common_binding: every table row binds contract_version, vault_id, authority_instance_id and restore_epoch; agent-scoped rows bind agent_id/auth_epoch; credentials, sessions, requests, activities, policy, audit/event records, snapshots/cursors, outbox, restore and backups additionally bind the applicable global generation and transport/state coordinates specified in core section 4.2
D0-4.authored_uid_rule: authority IDs are lowercase UUIDv7; source GKX authored UIDs preserve Full 808d875 UUID versions 1 through 8 including legacy lowercase UUIDv4 and may not silently reuse the authority UUIDv7 scalar
D0-4.timestamp_rule: real Gregorian UTC instant exactly YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ss.sssZ, years 1970 through 9999; missing milliseconds, offsets, impossible dates and date-only forms rejected
D0-4.global_authority_event_chain: one globally monotonic global_event_seq interleaves bootstrap, identity, retention, effect outbox/bridge and restore events; same-transaction meta head advance; startup rejects duplicates, aliases, forks and gaps inside the active segment; only an explicit restore event may start a new active segment at old_anchor_seq+1 with predecessor equal to the protected old anchor head
D0-4.restore_event_binding: one discriminated restore_events table: authority_restore targets a new authority_instance and binds pre-restore actor, backup, old/new authority chain, replacement owner and revoked/closed/invalidated aggregates; authority_restore_abort targets restore_plan in the unchanged old authority and binds plan/candidate/abandoned credential/temp disposition, false activation/publication proofs, abort intent and tombstone; the variants reject each other's fields
D0-4.opaque_reference_binding: navigation.discover with scope_ref null and cursor null is the only initial issuer of authorized root scope_ref, record_ref and child scope_ref; later reuse is same-session only; graph.temporal.read requires and resolves a non-null live same-session scope_ref and may issue only in-scope record_ref values; mappings are process-memory-only and bind session/agent/auth_epoch/generation/policy/filter/physical identity/expiry; page_snapshot stores only issued_reference_count and issued_reference_set_digest
D0-4.anchor_filename: gka1_ plus lowercase unpadded base32 of first 130 bits of SHA-256(GKOS-AUTHORITY-ANCHOR-NAME-V1 NUL vault_id), then .json
D0-4.anchor_update: fsynced MUTATION_INTENT -> one SQLite event/meta transaction and flush -> atomically replaced COMMITTED anchor and verified intent removal
D0-4.canonical_json: record digest bytes use recursive UTF-16 code-unit key order, semantic array order, JSON safe integers only, and UTF-8 without BOM or terminal LF; contract files add exactly one terminal LF

D0-5.race_rule: read results linearize at the final authority gate; irreversible effects linearize through the A-to-E bridge and immutable Effects terminal, never a cross-store SQLite/result transaction; stale work may publish neither result nor effect
D0-5.cross_store_order: persistent authority lease A is the authoritative cross-process synchronization domain; acquire A then effects lease E, never E then A; SQLite transactions are short mutation transactions under A and never wait for E or span Effects/filesystem work
D0-5.effect_bridge: append-only globally sequenced authority events PREPARED -> EFFECT_TERMINAL_OBSERVED -> AUDIT_PUBLISHED -> optional RECOVERED, with exact anchor update for each authority event, A->E restart reconciliation and success only after audit publication

D0-6.bootstrap_owner_proof: local nonredirected owner CLI, verified vault owner UID/SID, exclusive authority lease, and retyped random 128-bit vault-bound challenge; no listener or existing credential
D0-6.bootstrap_source: explicit bootstrap.initialize after owner proof always creates one owner identity and gkos1 owner credential; its required legacy_source field is absent or desktop_agent_token and must exactly match the physically qualified canonical .gkx/desktop-agent.token state; a valid present owner-protected regular non-link 64-lowercase-hex file creates a distinct legacy agent
D0-6.bootstrap_source_errors: omitted legacy_source is GKOS_P6_INVALID_PARAMS; declaration/observed-state mismatch is GKOS_P6_MIGRATION_CONFLICT; declared-present malformed source is GKOS_P6_MIGRATION_MALFORMED; no alternate path or caller suppression of a present source
D0-6.default_identity: no anonymous/default caller identity; explicit secure bootstrap creates exactly one service-generated owner identity
D0-6.bootstrap_owner_credential: credential_role owner_admin, gkos1, atomically staged in the persistent protected default client locator before database publication; repeat owner administration requires that locator
D0-6.legacy_credential_id: gkc0_ plus first 130 bits of the legacy domain-separated digest in lowercase RFC4648 base32
D0-6.idempotency: SHA-256 of canonical vault_id, legacy secret digest, target schema version, and bootstrap purpose
D0-6.terminal_legacy_state: OWNER_ACTIVE then COMPLETE when no legacy token exists; otherwise LEGACY_ACTIVE until authenticated owner rotation/revocation retires and removes the legacy token
D0-6.restore: standard authority.restore is initiated by an owner authenticated against the current pre-restore authority; it rotates authority_instance_id/restore_epoch, advances generation, revokes all restored credentials, closes sessions, invalidates cursors/idempotency, inserts one fresh active owner_admin credential, and uses RESTORE_PLAN_STAGED -> RESTORE_OWNER_LOCATOR_STAGED -> RESTORE_INTENT -> COMMITTED
D0-6.restore_replacement_owner_credential: fresh D0-3 gkos1 credential for the one restored owner identity, bound to new authority_instance_id/restore_epoch/generation/auth_epoch and atomically written once to a protected no-replace persistent client locator; after commit only this replacement owner credential authorizes administration
D0-6.restore_plan_temporary: before RESTORE_PLAN_STAGED fsync, atomically create/fsync an owner-protected no-replace temporary containing the 81 credential bytes plus LF; the staged plan binds its exact path, physical identity, content digest, protection descriptor, owner, regular-file/no-link status, plan/credential IDs, backup/candidate digests, and new authority coordinates
D0-6.restore_plan_recovery: after RESTORE_PLAN_STAGED fsync and before locator rename, an exact matching temporary is never deleted: startup validates every bound path/identity/content/ACL/no-link field, resumes only the no-replace atomic rename to the absent final locator, fsyncs the parent, and advances to RESTORE_OWNER_LOCATOR_STAGED without regeneration or re-reveal; missing/corrupt/aliased mismatch returns GKOS_P6_AUTHORITY_CORRUPT, disables writes, and deletes nothing
D0-6.restore_abort: the authenticated pre-restore owner may invoke local owner-only authority.restore.abort only before candidate DB/anchor publication; a durable RESTORE_ABORT_INTENT drives idempotent cleanup, deletes only an exact safe temporary, preserves missing/unsafe disposition, appends one globally sequenced closed receipt, and tombstones the plan before a new plan/credential is allowed; replay never regenerates under the old plan or reveals twice
D0-6.restore_abort_receipt: action authority_restore_abort, target restore_plan ID, predecessor current pre-restore event head; binds authenticated actor and old authority coordinates, plan/backup/candidate digests, proposed authority coordinates, abandoned credential ID/digest, expected temp identity/digests/protection, observed deleted_exact|absent|preserved_unsafe disposition, replacement_credential_active false, database_publication_started false, anchor_publication_started false, abort intent/tombstone digests and new event head
D0-6.restore_abort_errors: missing/corrupt/aliased planned temporary at startup is GKOS_P6_AUTHORITY_CORRUPT; abort outside the exact uncommitted state is GKOS_P6_STATE_CONFLICT; existing authentication codes are unchanged
D0-6.restore_crash_rule: after durable final locator staging, retry remains RESTORE_OWNER_LOCATOR_STAGED and revalidates/reuses the exact locator; it never generates a second credential, overwrites, regresses, or re-reveals
D0-6.bootstrap_db_rollback: after durable bootstrap locator staging, SQLite rollback remains OWNER_LOCATOR_STAGED and retries DB publication only after exact locator/plan/credential revalidation; never PLAN_STAGED
D0-6.bootstrap_sequence: UNINITIALIZED -> OWNER_PROVED -> PLAN_STAGED -> OWNER_LOCATOR_STAGED -> DB_COMMITTED -> ANCHOR_COMMITTED -> OWNER_ACTIVE, then exactly OWNER_ACTIVE -> COMPLETE when legacy_source=absent or OWNER_ACTIVE -> LEGACY_ACTIVE -> LEGACY_REVOKED -> COMPLETE when the valid legacy source was bound; no transition skips OWNER_LOCATOR_STAGED or OWNER_ACTIVE
D0-6.restore_receipt: actor local_owner_recovery, action authority_restore, target new authority_instance_id, predecessor equal to prior committed global event head; never genesis; binds pre-restore actor agent/credential/request/authority coordinates plus replacement owner agent/credential/auth_epoch and domain-separated locator binding digest

D0-7.scope_reference_issuance: navigation.discover with scope_ref null and cursor null authorizes and physically qualifies configured roots, then returns root scope_ref, record_ref and child scope_ref; later reuse is same-session only; capability.list_effective issues none; all are 128-bit opaque runtime references with durable aggregate authorization evidence in page_snapshot
D0-7.graph_temporal_scope: request requires non-null live canonical scope_ref plus at/state/cursor/limit; scope_ref.resolve and physical requalification precede policy/projectAtTime; filter and snapshot bind scope digest, session, agent, auth_epoch, generation, policy decision, physical identity, at, state and ordering; result echoes scope_ref and may issue only in-scope record_ref, never scope_ref
D0-7.cursor_wire: ^gkcur1_[A-Za-z0-9_-]{42}[AEIMQUYcgkosw048]$; exactly 32 decoded bytes and byte-identical unpadded re-encoding; final-E positive and final-B/final-D pad-bit aliases are frozen
D0-7.private_dependency_rule: record.validate and record.assess resolve/requalify input refs and mint none; record.lineage.read resolves/requalifies, snapshots/pages, and record_ref.issue mints related refs without physical discovery; graph.temporal.read, navigation.discover, and navigation.audit declare record_ref.discover before record_ref.issue plus their exact scope/path/snapshot/cursor dependencies
D0-7.unknown_operation_rule: any operation absent from the exact 32-entry inventory is unavailable and closes through the boundary-specific unknown-method or unknown-tool projection

D0-9.cross_register_rule: Core freezes paths/layout/counts without embedding interface proposal hashes; interface binds final core hashes; an independent later attestation hashes both sets.

D0-10.projection: peer GKOS_P6_PEER_FORBIDDEN/403/-32003; Host GKOS_P6_HOST_FORBIDDEN/403/-32003; Origin GKOS_P6_ORIGIN_FORBIDDEN/403/-32003; stage4 exact POST/DELETE pass and every other method category is GKOS_P6_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED/405/-32600 with Allow POST, DELETE; stage5 DELETE body/framing/Content-Type group is GKOS_P6_DELETE_INVALID/400/-32600 and POST Content-Type group is GKOS_P6_UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE/415/-32600; protocol-version group GKOS_P6_PROTOCOL_VERSION_INVALID/400/-32600; Accept GKOS_P6_NOT_ACCEPTABLE/406/-32600; session group GKOS_P6_SESSION_UNKNOWN/404/-32004 with required-missing session GKOS_P6_INVALID_REQUEST/400/-32600; auth group GKOS_P6_AUTH_FAILED/401/-32001. First failure wins; every stage 1-9 rejection uses the canonical envelope with null request_id even if an internal identifier exists. JSON-RPC unknown method remains HTTP 200/-32601; unknown tool remains -32602.
D0-10.unauthenticated_non_enumeration: all missing/malformed/unknown/disabled/revoked/expired/mismatched credential presentations coalesce to GKOS_P6_AUTH_FAILED; unknown/expired/closed/terminated MCP session IDs separately coalesce to one content-free GKOS_P6_SESSION_UNKNOWN HTTP 404
